##### Project general facts

Azizi Wares by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a refined exterior defined by a grid facade with integrated glass balconies and greenery. Warm metallic accents and clean vertical lines create an elegant, harmonious appearance within the urban landscape. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and three podium levels to seven residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with retail units on the lower levels.

Residents enjoy swimming pools for adults and children with a poolside lounge, separate gyms for men and women and a private cinema for relaxed evenings. A clubhouse, a game lounge, an indoor multipurpose hall, an indoor children's play area and lounges add variety, while a welcoming lobby, lifts, spacious parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Spacious layouts, ultra-modern interiors and panoramic windows create comfortable, light-filled spaces for living and working from home. Compact, efficient floor plans suit young professionals, couples and investors seeking practical homes close to major employment hubs. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is one of the leading business and logistics hubs of Dubai, home to Jebel Ali Port, the largest port in the Middle East, and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, where thousands of international companies are based. Residential neighbourhoods, community retail, cafes, schools and clinics sit close to the business district, giving residents a practical setting close to their workplaces.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Life Pharmacy metro station is close by. Expo City Dubai and Dubai Parks and Resorts are a short drive away, Ibn Battuta Mall, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Jumeirah Lake Towers are close by, and Al Maktoum International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable reach.

Jebel Ali offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible entry prices in western Dubai. A large working population in the free zone and the port supports steady demand from tenants seeking homes close to their workplaces. Continued infrastructure investment around Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport underpins attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
